query: What happens when Google Pixel 3 XL buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?
search_text: What happens when buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?

rows.text: It was ok. The phone it’s self would have been great if it didn’t have the problems that it had. From the sellers point they were good they took care of my refund

Phone stopped working after 2 weeks, no response from seller. Refunded by Amazon.. Looked brand new, everything worked as it should... Phone stopped working after 2 weeks, microphone suddenly became inoperable. No response from seller. Refunded by Amazon.
Broke in 5 months. No refund. Got this phone in April. It broke in September. The seller offered no help or refund. Money don't the drain.
Phone came with the sound not working and broken.. the phone does not work came dirty and the speaker sound is extremely low, must be plugged in the work. the seller wouldn't issue a refund.
Faulty charger. Phone came well but the charger wasn't working had to go buy a new charger

Great customer service. The phone arrived quickly and in great condition. It came with a faulty charging cable but the seller immediately remedied the situation. I would purchase from this seller again.

Don't buy. The phone cuts off even when its fully charged. I've contacted the sellers 3 times no response. The volume doesn't work. The screen keeps blinking on and off. I paid to much for this phone and it wasn't worth it I will never buy anything else from this seller.

Microphone doesn't work. The product received had minor cosmetic damage to all edges of the device, as well as some minor damage to the bottom speaker grill (which also houses the main mic). I was willing to accept this as the cost of buying refurbished, but the phone soon stopped accepting input from said main mic, meaning calls can only be made in speakerphone, and any other apps that use the mic won't work. This phone was ineligible for exchange, meaning that I have to return the phone, wait for the seller to confirm that they've received it, wait for a refund, use the refund to buy a new phone, and then wait to receive the new phone. This is immensely inconvenient considering that the phone is otherwise functional and I'll likely be without a phone for weeks, perhaps a month, as a result.

DOESN'T PROVIDE CUSTOMER SERVICE. Phone doesn't charge and/or charger doesn't work. Not near any stores to compare. This seller doesn't provide customer support, so buyer beware! Seller sold me an incomplete and totally untested package.

The seller's description of the phone's condition was grossly misleading.. The seller's description of the phone's condition is good.But the condition of the phone I received was like coming back from the war.

Manufacturer's Warranty is a CHEAT!. My wife cracked her screen and put in a Verizon insurance claim to get it repaired. However, uBreakiFix said they couldn't repair it because there was an internal PART MISSING. This was clearly a MANUFACTURING DEFECT. I reached out to Verizon and escalated the issue, but they declined to help and sent me to Google tech support. Google also declined saying that I'd need to get the screen fixed before they could help, which left me in a catch-22. So, bottom line, I was sold A DEFECTIVE PHONE and was forced to pay a replacement phone deductible ($199) to get it replaced. I suspect the uBreakiFix contract may have been specifically setup to ensnare customers into paying the full deductible when the screen breaks, while Google manufacturing cut corners on their phones, all so they can't be fixed.

Unusable after 6 months, faulty screen.. Screen progressively getting worse and unusable after 6 month mark,. It's just out of the return window and seller refuses to work with me at all even went as far as to suggest I could pay for a replacement and got the same caned response about warranty window. Would not recommend, screen replacement costs more than the phone.

TAKE HEED. NOT AS DESCRIBED - UNFUNCTIONAL PHONE. IF I COULD GIVE THIS - STARS I WOULD! I ORDERED THIS PHONE JULY 16TH AND RECEIVED IT ON THE 29TH SO I HAVE HAD THIS PHONE FOR 35 DAYS! I WAS EXPECTING TO RECEIVE A DEVICE WHICH IS FULLY FUNCTIONAL AND IN GOOD SHAPE AS DESCRIBED. UPON RECEIPT, I NOTICED THAT THE PHONE HAD SO MANY DEEP SCRATCHES AND SCUFF MARKS THAT EVEN WITH A PRIVACY OR SCREEN PROTECTOR WAS VISIBLE. I CONTACTED THE SELLER TO INFORM HIM OF MY DISATISFACTION AND AFTER A BACK AND FORTH HE AGREED TO REFUNDS ME A SMALL % BACK. ALTHOUGH I WOULD HAVE PREFERRED ALL OF MY MONEY BACK I ACCEPTED THE SMALL REFUND AND THOUGH THAT I COULD GO ON.

This wasn't exactly a huge deal, as selecting "continue" simply lead to a factory reset. I had initiated a refund during this time, but gave into my hubris and ultimately decided not to return the phone. This was a terrible idea. 2 days after my return window had ended, I went to bed and woke up with a bricked Pixel 3 XL. Some troubleshooting later, I learned that, according to Google, this was the result of the natural lifeline of the internal hardware. There is no fix for this issue except buying a new phone. The initial symptoms of this issue? The Bluetooth, WiFi, and GPS not working. These issues took less than a month to happen to my phone. I refuse to believe that this phone left the company's warehouse unaware of these issues.

Badd phone. Phone microphone didn't work at all it was all up to date software was up to date but it was faulty and they have yet to contact me back about exchanging it for a functional device and Esim for Google Fi wouldn't download smh

So I'm returning it. If the camera worked I'm sure I'd love it. The Pixel 3 does have unlimited high res backups to Google Photos. So if you have one where the camera works, then excellent! I'll update this later based on my experience with the return handling. If you select to return, Amazon contacts the seller who will then contact you (me in this case) with instructions. I'm still waiting on that. 4 stars for now because I really like the phone (aside from camera not focusing, which also seems to happen quite a bit looking around online) but it is NOT NEW. So don't tell me I'm getting a new phone when the box is not even sealed.

Phone is broken - the earpiece cannot be turned up and the speaker is blown.. Phone is broken - the earpiece cannot be turned up and the speaker is blown. Have contacted the seller for some kind of resolution. I didn't spend a ton of money but having it wasted on something that doesn't work is aggravating.

Not "works and looks like new" as described. I received my "renewed" phone and was severely disappointed in the quality. The speakers and microphone are clogged with dirt and there are several scratches on the screen glass. I would return it but I cannot live without a phone for the several days it would take to process a refund. Buyer beware, this is not the phone you're looking for.

2nd defective phone. Returned first one after months of aggravation, now the second one is faulty. These are probably defective phones just handed off without testing. Wish I had never bought this. Now I'm stuck trying to get another replacement, after months of problems, in this case people telling me quite frequently now that "I'm breaking up", when I hear them fine, and it happens a lot, even with strong signal, regardless of location or signal strength.

Purchased last October, it stopped working by end of January and waiting to hear back from seller.. I purchased the google pixel 3xl last October. It worked great up until the end of January. So only worked for 3 months. It won't turn on at all. I tried everything suggested on youtube. Contacted Amazon to reach out to seller to see what my options are as of Jan. 31, told to wait 48 hours, I did and nothing. Contacted them again and told to wait another 48 hours. I hope I get a response from the seller about what my options are, whether its a refund or something.
